mapper.insert: INSERT INTO fk_reim_subsidy (id, main_id, traveler_id, traveler_no, traveler_name, departure_date, arrival_date, subsidy_days, departure_city, departure_city_no, arriving_city, arriving_city_no, application_amount, subsidy_amount, meal_allowance, transportation_allowance, phone_allowance, business_type_id, business_type_no, business_type_name) VALUES (#{id}, #{mainId}, #{travelerId}, #{travelerNo}, #{travelerName}, #{departureDate}, #{arrivalDate}, #{subsidyDays}, #{departureCity}, #{departureCityNo}, #{arrivingCity}, #{arrivingCityNo}, #{applicationAmount}, #{subsidyAmount}, #{mealAllowance}, #{transportationAllowance}, #{phoneAllowance}, #{businessTypeId}, #{businessTypeNo}, #{businessTypeName})
